subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the number on the face opposite 12.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9075af3f481f4b71a36c32161c93d50bf769df23d7d6fec7420b46ad81364c08.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '12', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 2 and Dice 3,

When we move in clockwise direction starting from 12 we get;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b2c6bb08d86cbb1e78df1a8215aad2a3a619fae33533bfbbca6bdbd7075893d.png] 

→ 12 ⇔ 12; 9 ⇔ 10; 8 ⇔ 7

So, the remaining '11' will be the opposite face of '12'.

Hence, the correct answer is "11".
